compute_upper_tail_quantile: compute the upper tail quantile for a PyTorch distribution given a desired tail mass value
estimate_upper_tail_for_range_coding: estimate the upper tail cutoff for range coding overflow handling on a continuous distribution
get_upper_tail_with_icdf: get the upper tail quantile using the distribution inverse CDF method when icdf is available
estimate_upper_tail_fallback: estimate the upper tail quantile using Adam-based optimization when icdf is not implemented
review_upper_tail_function: review the upper_tail function that approximates tail quantiles for range coding of random variables
